description: Complete a local pending source publication after polling its operation. Uses the owner-only directory record and verified login, checks the exact confirmed source manifest, and stores that operation's commit as this directory's base even when another chat has advanced main. Never reads a fresh remote head as the local base. No files are uploaded and no deployment starts.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: source_publish_complete
